description: PROPOSED immutable draft 2020-12 schemas; C:38–53,115–125,171–175. All object shapes closed and required. Freeze v4 §4 defines binding validation beyond JSON Schema: canonical hashes, authentication, reference resolution without cycles, state arithmetic, current observations, containment and durability are mandatory semantic checks. These schemas and catalog are static design, no real-pair acceptance. Acyclic typed argv bindings, physically independent R_rec recovery, three closed fencing variants; examples live at x-construction.examples so the standard draft 2020-12 examples annotation retains its array type. D13 origin trace revision.

Copied receipt alone never authenticates a peer. observed_authority_epoch/observed_sequence bind the old committed pair; proposed_epoch is nonnull for INITIALIZE/RECONCILE only. Absent/missing authority requires null/null and independent proof.

Refusal creates no new revision.
